content: I just learned from #batteries > Upstreaming Nat.Bits @ 💬 that mathlib has two implementation of positives numbers: docs#PosNum which is the same as the recently merged Pos in Iris Lean. It seems like this definition is deprecated in favor of docs#PNat, which is implemented by Nat and thus more efficient for computation. Not sure if there is anything to do about this, but maybe this is interesting to be aware of.
Good find, but since this data structure is only used internally for namespaces I think it's no problem.
